title: Abra begins operating
description: Abra developed as a crypto app and investment platform offering trading, account, and later yield-like products.

title: State regulatory actions target Abra Earn and related products
description: U.S. state regulators took action against Abra-related entities over crypto account and yield-like products including Abra Earn and Abra Boost.

title: Abra reaches multi-state settlement requiring customer refunds
description: Abra and affiliated entities reached a multi-state settlement requiring repayment to customers and restrictions on certain U.S. crypto activities.
